ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes, any cookie/consent/gdpr-named element inside a fixed/sticky/high-z overlay)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: remove main .facebook-feed (live Facebook posts rendered client-side as a desktop grid + a duplicate mobile carousel); the section heading above the feed stays in scope
ledger.why: third-party runtime data, not authored page content: post text and images change between loads, so byte equality cannot hold; carried as a dynamic surface (dynamics disposition: embed/defer) rather than as static content — same rule as home N1
UI chrome injected by the source theme, no content bytes; donor kit has its own Back to Top module

ledger.what: expand every main .nsw-accordion: drop hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content and set the button aria-expanded="true"
ledger.why: collapsed panels are authored content absent from innerText (hidden); without expansion the byte reference silently drops every accordion body. Same rule as the default de-carousel (N-D2): interactive disclosure is normalized to all-open, and the reskin renders each item title followed by its panel statically in DOM order

metadata.title: Events
metadata.description: At Fort Street High School, our events are an important part of your child’s learning and school experience. They help students build confidence, connect with others and celebrate their progress. Events also give families a chance to be involved in school life and share in their child’s achievements.

visibleTextNormalized: Events School events bring learning to life and help shape our school culture. They help students build confidence, connect with others and celebrate their progress. Events also give families a chance to be involved in school life and share in their child’s achievements. Our school event may include: school orientation days sports carnivals open day and school tours Harmony Week and Book Week events excursions and incursions performances, concerts or school productions fundraising, charity and community events award assemblies graduation and other celebrations. Contact us to learn more about our events. Important Calendar Dates to start 2027 Wednesday 3 February All students return to school. Year 7 first day For Year 7 - Introduction to Fort Street High School commences at 9:00am. Monday February 8 Swimming Carnival Canterbury Leisure & Aquatic Centre Wednesday 10 – Friday 12 February Year 7 Camp Information will be provided to parents and carers before the end of Term 4, 2026. Wednesday 10 – Friday 12 February Year 11 Camp Information will be provided to parents and carers before the end of Term 4, 2026. Wednesday 24 February School Photographs Day Information and Photo Sheets will be sent home for parents/carers to place their order and return to the photographer on the day. Students are to wear full school uniform which includes the school tie. Tuesday 2 March Catchup Photographs Day For students absent on School Photographs Day, this will be the final opportunity to have their individual photo taken. Friday 26 February; commencing at 10:00am Speech Day at the State Theatre The annual school Speech Day is a compulsory event for all students. Students must be in full school uniform at this event which includes the school tie. A permission to attend note will be sent to all parents/carers. Year 7 students make their way to State Theatre and released at the end of Speech Day, around 1:00pm. Roll Call will occur before students enter State Theatre. Parents will receive a text message if their child is unexplained absence or have arrived late. Students who require teacher supervision will be escorted back to school until 3.15pm. Featured events See what’s happening at our school. Visit Our community to volunteer at our events. HSC Examinations Date: Tuesday 13 October - Thursday 5 November Time: All day Gold Duke of Edinburgh Hike Date: Thursday 15 October - Sunday 18 October Time: All Day Silver Duke of Edinburgh Hike Date: Thursday 22 October - Saturday 24 October Time: All Day SRC Halloween Event Date: Friday 30 October Students may dress up in costume for the lunchtime competition. There will be a photo booth and trick or treating. Secondhand Uniform Stall Date: Friday 6 November Time: Students only from 12:45pm. Parents/Carers are welcome from 1pm. This is a cashless, card only event. Year 7 Gala Day Date: Thursday 5 November Rememberance Day and SRC Induction Assembly Date: Wednesday 11 November P&C Annual General Meeting Date: Wednesday 11 November Time: In the school library from 7.30pm You are invited to attend the P&C General Meeting in the School Library. All community members are very welcome. MAD night Date: Wednesday 18 November School Spectacular Date: Wednesday 25 November - Saturday November 28 Year 7 2027 Orientation Day Date: Tuesday Dec 1 IMP Summer Concert Date: Sunday 13 December HSC Results Celebration morning tea Date: Wednesday 16 December Last day of school Date: Thursday 17 December Need to make a payment?
